NB: the top-7 plus Mbale Dairy-Heroes qualified for the 8-team first
division 1998 (presumable SCOUL's record above is incorrect); the
bottom four were relegated; while 5 teams (Toro, Pamba (Lira),
Health (Entebbe), Military Police (Kampala) and Roraima) came
up to the new 9-team second division.
